name: What is the difference between a home office addition and a renovation of an existing space?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a home office addition and a renovation of an existing space?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home office addition involves constructing an entirely new structure or expanding your home's footprint to create the office space. This typically includes foundation work, new walls, roofing, and utilities. A renovation, on the other hand, involves transforming an existing room within your current home into a home office. While both create a dedicated workspace, an addition provides more flexibility in terms of size and location, whereas a renovation is limited by the existing structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: An addition builds new space from scratch, while a renovation converts an existing room. Additions offer more design flexibility.
